instruction.name: xvstelm.h
instruction.description: Store element `lane` of `data` to memory address `addr + offset`. Address misalignment does not raise an exception. The `offset` operand is a byte offset; the encoded instruction stores it as a scaled immediate for wider elements.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvstelm.h $xr0, $r20, 0, 0; xvstelm.h $xr1, $r20, 2, 0; xvstelm.h $xr2, $r20, 4, 0; xvstelm.h $xr3, $r20, 6, 0; xvstelm.h $xr4, $r20, 8, 0; xvstelm.h $xr5, $r20, 10, 0; xvstelm.h $xr6, $r20, 12, 0; xvstelm.h $xr7, $r20, 14, 0
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr7, $r4; addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr7, $r4; addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r4' --asm 'xvstelm.h $xr0, $r20, 0, 0; xvstelm.h $xr1, $r20, 2, 0; xvstelm.h $xr2, $r20, 4, 0; xvstelm.h $xr3, $r20, 6, 0; xvstelm.h $xr4, $r20, 8, 0; xvstelm.h $xr5, $r20, 10, 0; xvstelm.h $xr6, $r20, 12, 0; xvstelm.h $xr7, $r20, 14, 0'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 5.39 cycles. Buffer is 64-byte aligned; unaligned LASX loads/stores are substantially slower. The measured CPI 0.5012 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: Vector memory operation. Throughput measured with a hot, 64-byte-aligned 1KB stack buffer; latency not measured because it depends on cache/coherence state and needs a separate dependency chain.
